title: V = x² and its rate −2x⁴
caption: V = x² is positive away from 0 and V̇ = 2x(−x³) = −2x⁴ is negative away from 0, so the energy-like V always decreases: the origin is asymptotically stable.
alt: Two curves: V = x², a parabola above the axis, and V̇ = −2x⁴, a flat-bottomed curve below the axis, both touching zero only at x = 0.
description: Take V = x², positive for every x ≠ 0.
V̇ < 0 for every x ≠ 0, so V falls to 0 and the origin is globally asymptotically stable.
